name: Frosted Glass
description: A smooth, diffused backdrop that gives your desktop a little breathing room.

controls.label: Thickness
controls.description: The Frosted Glass thickness control from COSMIC Settings.

controls.label: Opacity
controls.description: Shared across Frosted Glass, Crystal and Aero.

name: Crystal
description: Uneven facets, refracted light and a little depth. Make it expressive, or keep a calm center for everyday work.

controls.label: Everyday mode
controls.description: A calmer reading center with reflections near the edges.

controls.label: Frost
controls.description: From clear crystal to a fully diffused surface.

controls.label: Thickness
controls.description: Add internal depth and light scattering.

controls.label: Refraction
controls.description: How strongly the glass bends the backdrop.

controls.label: Facet density
controls.description: Fewer broad faces or more fine crystal cuts.

controls.label: Opacity
controls.description: Shared across Frosted Glass, Crystal and Aero.

name: Aero Glass
description: Smooth glass, broad diagonal reflections and a bright, fine rim. Its color follows your system accent and light or dark theme.

controls.label: Blur
controls.description: Keep the background clear or soften it into glass.

controls.label: Theme color
controls.description: How much of your system color comes through.

controls.label: Reflections
controls.description: Adjust the diagonal sheen and the glass rim.

controls.label: Opacity
controls.description: Shared across Frosted Glass, Crystal and Aero.
